Get ready to scale the highest heights for action-packed stacking game fun with **Rhino Hero –** the high-stakes, tower-stacking adventure that everyone in the family will love! In this fun and strategic game, players become Rhino Hero’s team, building a towering skyscraper for him to scale in his quest to catch burglars and troublemakers. Perfect for families and groups, Rhino Hero is designed for 2-5 players ages 5 and up, making it an excellent choice for family game time, classroom play, parties, or playdates.
